items.headline: Nvidia ($3B) and AMD ($1B) to invest in Meta's $95B AI-infrastructure equity raise; Broadcom also weighing a stake
items.why: Chip suppliers are now financing their own biggest AI capex customer, tightening the Nvidia-AMD-Meta compute loop and signaling capex isn't peaking

items.headline: Anthropic files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO (ANT), up to ~$100B raise targeted at ~$2T valuation; discloses $417B in future compute obligations
items.why: Would be the largest IPO ever and quantifies how much AI labs must commit to compute - a direct read on AI financing risk and infra demand

items.headline: Meta launches up to $95B stock offering ($35B immediate, $60B Class C in 2027) to fund AI data centers
items.why: Shows hyperscalers turning to equity markets to finance surging AI capex, a funding model other labs may copy

items.headline: SpaceX locks in ~$40B GPU/data-center financing deal with Apollo Global Management via a lease structure
items.why: Shows AI capex spreading via off-balance-sheet leasing even to non-AI-core companies - a structure to watch for hidden leverage

items.headline: SK's data-center unit in talks to fund a $350B AI buildout
items.why: One of the largest AI infrastructure financing plans reported this year, underscoring capex scale across the chip/memory supply chain

items.headline: OpenAI nears up to $30B funding round at $1.25T valuation (revised down from $1.4T), led by UAE investors and Coatue
items.why: Sets the market's benchmark valuation for OpenAI ahead of a 2027 IPO and signals sovereign capital's growing role in AI financing

items.headline: DeepSeek raises ~$15B equity round; Huawei secures $2.25B bank loan; CATL and Tencent among investors
items.why: China's AI champions raising large capital despite US export curbs, deepening the DeepSeek-Huawei chip alliance that competes with Nvidia

items.headline: Nvidia and supply-chain partners announce capacity expansion to accelerate AI infrastructure buildout
items.why: Signals Nvidia moving to ease the capacity bottlenecks constraining AI chip and server supply

items.headline: Nvidia's guarantees and commitments backing new AI data centers reach up to $164.5B, report says
items.why: Shows scale of Nvidia's off-balance-sheet exposure to the AI buildout, a key solvency/circularity risk

items.headline: Anthropic reportedly eyeing IPO as early as mid-November at ~$2T valuation, up from $965B private mark
items.why: Would be the largest AI IPO yet and a key read on public-market appetite for AI-lab valuations

items.headline: PBOC signals shift to the overnight repo rate as its new policy anchor, a de facto ~15bp easing
items.why: A real easing move from China's central bank loosens funding conditions into a slowing economy - relevant for China-exposed AI and tech names

items.headline: China Q3 GDP grows 4.5% y/y, beating estimates and accelerating from Q2's 4.3%
items.why: Stronger China growth supports domestic AI capex (Alibaba, Tencent, Huawei) and eases hard-landing tail risk for global markets.

items.headline: Anthropic in talks to buy ~$45B of AI computing power from neocloud Nscale
items.why: Another multi-billion-dollar forward compute commitment from Anthropic underscores the scale of buying propping up neocloud build-outs

items.headline: Anthropic framed as the AI sector's last major 2026 IPO hope, seeking up to $2T valuation vs. investor pushback toward $1.5T
items.why: Would be the first major AI-lab public listing, resetting public-market comps for AI valuations
